mentions.name: Personal AI Librarian
mentions.description: This AI-powered personal librarian makes large collections of local epub and pdf files accessible again. It helps users rediscover forgotten files, find information by meaning, explore unexpected connections, and save discoveries for future interests or projects.
mentions.problem: Large local collections of epub and pdf files become inaccessible and forgotten over time.
mentions.source_excerpt: A personal AI librarian that makes large collections of local epub's and pdf's accessible again. It helps people rediscover forgotten files, find information by meaning, explore unexpected connections, and save discoveries for future interests or projects.
mentions.author: markcheno
